C wf011.concrete-defects OL WF-011,WF-012 MUST ;; Review the actual changed behaviour and identify concrete defects or risks; code review is not the completion checklist (verify is). ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.priorities OL WF-011 MUST ;; Priorities: correctness, security/authorization, data integrity/persistence, architecture boundaries, concurrency/integration, meaningful tests, maintainability, evidenced performance; style never above defects. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.scope OL WF-010,WF-001 MUST ;; Establish what is reviewed and read changed code plus enough surrounding code; no isolated-line review. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf010.intent OL WF-010 MUST ;; Identify behaviour changed, expected errors, persistence/external effects and protecting tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.review-read-owners OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read owning rules for every changed area (path rules may not have loaded for diff-only files) and relevant knowledge skills before judging conformance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov003.conformance OL GOV-003,GOV-006 MUST ;; Check product conformance both ways: missing/weakened required behaviour and unapproved behaviour (limits, reserved values, required fields, workflow restrictions, validation, string semantics incl. DB collation/framework defaults). ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov005.approved-details OL GOV-005,GOV-004,GOV-007 MUST ;; Approved and synchronized details absent from the spec are not defects; do not confuse internal details with product behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.plausible OL WF-012,WF-011 MUST ;; Look for concrete behavioural problems; do not invent failures without a plausible execution path. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.architecture-checks OL WF-011,ARC-001,ARC-008,ARC-010,ARC-013,ARC-014,ARC-016,ARC-020,GOV-012 MUST ;; Check architecture.md and persistence-technology.md: Domain independence, no Infrastructure/technology types in Application, thin Controllers, specific repositories without leaking queryable/technology types, UoW commit boundary, proportional complexity without unapproved patterns. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf012.not-unadopted OL WF-012,ARC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not report a violation merely because code differs from an unadopted pattern. ;; = ;; none ;;
C fe.review-frontend OL FE-003,FE-007,FE-009,FE-012,SEC-005,FE-006,FE-002 MUST ;; Check frontend.md/frontend-framework.md (feature boundaries, data-access boundary, subscription lifetime, error handling, guards not server auth, unnecessary global state, meaningful tests); do not apply backend project rules mechanically to frontend code. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.data-security OL WF-011,SEC-004,SEC-003,SEC-010,PST-008,PST-010,RUN-021 MUST ;; When relevant check commits/transactions, destructive changes, raw SQL parameterization, authorization, trust boundaries, secrets, sensitive logging, concurrency, migrations, cache consistency and seed-data co-change. ;; = ;; When relevant. ;;
C wf007.scan-when-warranted OL WF-007,WF-020 MUST ;; Use the full security-scan only on request, for materially security-sensitive changes or a concrete finding; not every review is a full OWASP audit. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.integrations OL RUN-003,RUN-015,RUN-016,RUN-005 MUST ;; For external calls check cancellation, timeouts, idempotency, retry safety, failure translation and lifetime; never demand unsafe retries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C tst.review-tests OL TST-009,TST-010,TST-011,TST-003 MUST ;; Check useful maintained coverage (behaviour not lines), regression tests for plausible recurrence, preserved probes; no duplicate tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf011.credible-perf OL WF-011,RUN-008 MUST ;; Report performance concerns only with credible reasons; no speculative optimization recommendations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.tooling-evidence OL WF-021,WF-012 MUST ;; Use diagnostics/analyzers/check-architecture when useful; no MCP server or analyzer required; tool output is evidence, read code before turning warnings into findings. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-output-format EX WF-011 MUST ;; Report findings by severity with severity, location, problem, impact and smallest fix, using the Critical/High/Medium/Low definitions. ;; = ;; none ;; Output format and severity scale not in the oracle.
C wf012.no-manufactured OL WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not manufacture findings; when none are meaningful say so and name important unverifiable areas. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.cr-no-filler-praise EX WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add filler praise to balance criticism. ;; = ;; none ;; Output-tone rule not in WF-012.
C wf011.discipline OL WF-011,WF-010,WF-012 MUST_NOT ;; During review do not rewrite working code unless asked, report tooling-owned formatting as defects, demand personal style, assume every warning is a bug, or require unadopted patterns. ;; = ;; none ;;
